% A guard: it checks cases that the fix of files read with the primitive
% \input from a package of the document must not break.
% A package of the document beside it, loaded after the packages it
% builds on, as is usual, reads two files with the primitive \input.
% - test-ownprim/framed.tex, named like framed.4ht, after the framed
%   package. As in the PDF, the file's text is in the page, and tex4ht
%   keeps its configuration of the package: framed.4ht defines
%   \a:makeframed, so the page shows that it was read, as for any
%   document that loads framed.
% - LaTeX's dvipsnam.def, from TeX's tree, after xcolor. The file names
%   itself \ProvidesFile{dvipsnam.def}, so tex4ht reads dvipsnam.4ht,
%   which the TeX log lists. As in the PDF, a named color keeps its
%   value.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{framed}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage{test-ownprim-after}
\begin{document}
Framed: \ownprimframed
\expandafter\ifx\csname a:makeframed\endcsname\relax\else\par Framed read for the web.\fi\par
\textcolor[named]{BrickRed}{Brick red text.}
\end{document}
